title: Daily Reels: an Instagram reel every day, automatically
summary: Renders a branded 9:16 reel plus caption every day from photo albums and film clips, a week ahead, into a synced folder ready to post.
how_to_use: Mostly a reference for building your own. It's wired to Jesse's photography site and albums.
requires: ffmpeg and Python. You'd need to point it at your own photos and branding.
